110240301.text: I will remain here for a while. I fear that moments of reminiscence like this can only grow fewer.

110240303.text: We did not measure right and wrong during the days of the Archon War in the same manner as we do today.

110240304.text: Of course, as I am now... I only wish that she could have lived in a gentler time.

110240306.text: Though the salt chalice and salt ruler do have power in their own right, they are nothing before Osial.

110240307.text: If a day comes when he should recover his strength and return... Ha, I believe that even so, he will be defeated once more.

110240309.text: That is a good question. In the past, I might have given you a most specific answer.

110240310.text: But now... Yes, I suppose I will continue in my role as a consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor.

110240311.text: But if this journey was to your liking, why don't you come along the next time I am seeking to preserve memories of Liyue's past?
